_about: Exceptions to the usability lint (tools/agents/usability-lint.mjs, D-520), each with its reason: none is silent. Per rule, entries { file, path, lang, reason }; `*` matches any run of characters. An entry that no longer hits fails as stale, so remove it when its text changes.

U-2.reason: The ⚡ and 💧 are the board's own symbols (Loteo's utilities variant): the emoji is the noun, the way the player sees it on the board.
📌 and 🚫 are the marks the card shows after each long press: naming them by their symbol is how the player recognizes them.
The 🏆 is the badge shown next to the name: the emoji is the thing being described.
➕ is the game's button, named by its symbol in the rules.

U-5.reason: «Blanco móvil» is a moving target, not a phone: móvil as an adjective.
It warns not to reuse the bank's password (senha) as the PIN: the bank's word is the right one there.

U-6.reason: «The 1 asks for 1 square»: asks is a verb, not a plural noun.
One is the number of drinkers; {n} is SORBOS, a constant above 1.

U-17.reason: Not a button: its key «one» is the same as search.js's list button in public/assets.
A full-width row at the end of the search list (.buscar-todos), not a centered button: it may wrap with a long query.
A small text link (link-btn) at the bottom, the secondary kind U-17 allows to be longer.
The armed hint (the owner's choice in #351): it says what the second tap does, and it wraps centered.
Leaving a cup on this phone needs both parts to be unmistakable; a wide secondary button that wraps centered.
The disabled roll button's state message, not an action label: it explains why it cannot roll.
